evidence.claim: OpenAI's US policy describes its practices for personal data collected from or about you across its website, applications and services.
OpenAI says it also collects information from other sources, such as publicly available internet information, to develop the models that power its Services.

OpenAI points to its policy and a help center article for how training information is used and the choices available; Free and Go users can use advertising controls in account settings to control what data is used to personalize ads.
OpenAI says it receives information from advertisers and data partners to measure and improve its Services, including ads shown to Free and Go users.

Users can delete specific or all ChatGPT conversations or their account; OpenAI says it retains personal data only as long as needed to provide Services or for legitimate purposes such as safety and legal compliance.

OpenAI says it develops its models using training information (including some publicly available internet data), shows ads to Free and Go users with account controls, and allows deleting conversations, memories and accounts.

Exodus Privacy static analysis of version 1.2026.258 (report dated Sept. 21, 2026) found code signatures for 2 known tracker SDK(s): Segment (analytics profiling), Sentry (crash reporting). A signature shows the SDK is present, not what data it sends.
